description_en: Generates a real-time video stream processing channel that supports the HLS protocol and automatically assigns endpoints and keys
description_zh: 生成实时视频流处理频道，支持HLS协议，自动分配端点和密钥
kebab_example: aliyun ice create-live-package-channel --group-name channel-group-1 --segment-count 3 --description This_is_a_test_channel. --segment-duration 6 --channel-name channel-1 --client-token 000012e8864746a0a3980000 --protocol HLS --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateLivePackageChannel

parameters.help_en: The channel group name. The name can contain only uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores. The name must be 1 to 200 characters in length. Format: [A-Za-z0-9_-]+
parameters.help_zh: 频道组名称，字符必须为大小写英文字母、数字、短横线、下划线。1 ~ 200个字符。格式：[A-Za-z0-9_-]+
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The number of m3u8 segments for the input stream. Valid values: 2 to 100
parameters.name: segment_count

parameters.help_en: The description. The description can be up to 1000 characters in length
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The segment duration of the input stream, in seconds. Valid values: 1 to 30
parameters.name: segment_duration

parameters.help_en: The channel name. The name can contain only uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores. The name must be 1 to 200 characters in length. Format: [A-Za-z0-9_-]+
parameters.help_zh: 频道名称，字符必须为大小写英文字母、数字、短横线、下划线。1 ~ 200个字符。格式：[A-Za-z0-9_-]+
parameters.name: channel_name

parameters.help_en: The input protocol. Currently, only HLS is supported
parameters.name: protocol
